output_contract.compact: --compact retains recovery metadata and writes the complete reply to full_reply_path; full output remains the default.
output_contract.verification: Commit status is separate from pending/passed/failed/unavailable proof. A saved image cannot satisfy live proof. Never repeat a committed mutation to obtain evidence.
output_contract.stdout: Exactly one terminal JSON envelope per invocation.
output_contract.stderr: Progress and planned envelopes as NDJSON on stderr, plus diagnostics.
output_contract.stream: --stream moves progress/planned envelopes onto stdout (NDJSON) for single-stream callers.

exit_codes.0: completed — the terminal envelope carries status: completed. Observe commands (check, verify, shot) exit 0 with findings present: read data.findings/data.counts, not the exit code. A verify data.status of 'unavailable' means NOT verified, never a pass.
exit_codes.2: invalid input — fix the flagged field_errors; guide --command <name> --json shows the installed schema
exit_codes.3: blocked by checks or confirmation required — the reply carries the exact confirm_command to proceed
exit_codes.4: editor or owner unavailable — start Klippt with OPENSCREEN_AGENT_CLI=1 and open the project, then retry
exit_codes.5: revision or history conflict — re-read state/history and rebuild the plan against the current revision
exit_codes.6: timeout — commit state is unknown; query receipt with the original request_id before any new write
exit_codes.7: failed — the terminal envelope's error object carries code, message and hint

output_contract.confirmation: A reply blocked by checks exits 3 and carries confirm_command: the exact command that proceeds.
output_contract.findings: check and verify report findings in data and still exit 0. verify data.status 'unavailable' means deep content verification could NOT run for the range (error-level content.unavailable findings say why): the range is not verified and the reply must not read as a pass.
output_contract.versioning: api_version 1.x is additive-only: new commands and flags only. Removing or repurposing a flag requires a new major api_version.

capabilities.media_import: image/audio/video import-plan; video becomes a B-roll overlay (schema 11)
capabilities.rendered_visual_verification: preview: one PNG at speed-adjusted output time, including long recordings; bounded native still render

data.activation: Start with OPENSCREEN_AGENT_CLI=1 and keep a clean project open. Discovery and saved reads do not start the GUI.

commands.name: clone
commands.description: Copy a saved project file into the app's projects folder under a new project ID without touching media or the original. Returns the new ID and path.

workflow: Write a JSON array of operations; plan --project_id <id> --input <operations.json>
Review cuts: plan --stage; staged; accept; reject --ids a,b
Inspect/render the returned candidatePath before apply
If the result is unknown, timed out, or the plan expired: receipt --project_id <id> --request_id <original-id> before any new edit
data.revisions: Plans retain the exact prepared candidate and saved revision. Apply refuses a stale revision; preserve the request ID for replay/recovery. Saved snapshot hashes are read guards, not live mutation revisions.
